title: Why the roadmap must be a file
thesis: A plan that is not a file under version control, checked by the build, is not a plan.

nodes.text: A plan lives where the work lives, or it is not read.
A mechanical check reduces stale plan entries.
The forced-edit objection is true and does not matter.

evidence.filled_by: a small forced edit is where a reviewer looks

nodes.text: The rule: file, next to the code, build fails on disagreement.
